name: Clipboard Popup
description:
Windows-style clipboard history. Press Super+V to open a popup next to the pointer, pick an item and it is pasted into the window you were using.

- Text and images, newest first; copying something again moves it to the top
- Pin items to keep them; after a reboot only pinned items remain, like on Windows
- History survives the screen lock
- Keyboard: arrows, Enter to paste, Delete to remove, Esc to close
- Pastes with Ctrl+Shift+V in terminals
- Passwords copied from password managers (KeePassXC, Bitwarden) are not saved
- Frees Super+V from the notification list while enabled and gives it back when disabled
